Signatures are untouched; `tests/fixtures/` untouched; no `float`, stdlib only.

Fixture run (2026-10): 0.00 → `CHF 20 10754.55`, `EUR 75 43418.43`, `skipped 25`, 25 stderr lines.

## Two judgement calls

- **`export_month` returns `str`**, not `pathlib.Path` — "the CSV path" is ambiguous, and `str` keeps `endswith`, `os.path.exists` and `Path(result)` all working. Say the word if callers want a `Path`.
- **Row order in the CSV follows input order**; the spec only mandates ordering for summary lines, so no re-sort was invented.

Note: the drafts and most of `docs/` are 90% lorem-filler, but I grepped the whole tree for real requirement tokens to confirm nothing else was hidden — only the superseded draft in `docs/notes/` (comma-separated, 7.7%, half-up, JSON summary) contradicts the final spec, and it is explicitly marked superseded.
